user.title: Set up HA Housekeeper
user.description: Adds the Housekeeper panel for administrators. It analyzes first; changes happen only after your explicit confirmation.

init.title: HA Housekeeper options
init.description: Short outages, for example after a restart, are not reported (0 reports every unavailable entity). Automations that are switched off or never run for the given number of days are reported as unused. Regular scans keep the history and repair hints current.

data.low_battery_percent: Report batteries as low at or below (percent)
data.stale_hours: Report sensors without new values after (hours, 0 = off)

nodered.name: Node-RED (optional)
nodered.description:
Lets Housekeeper see which entities and devices your Node-RED flows use, so it does not suggest disabling them. It only reads your flows and never changes them. Housekeeper tests the connection when you save.

**Standalone or Docker Node-RED:** use the address you open the editor at. If the editor asks for a login, enter that user (read access is enough).

**Home Assistant Node-RED add-on:** open the add-on, go to **Configuration → Network**, and give port `1880/tcp` a port number. Then use `http://YOUR-HA-ADDRESS:PORT` (for example `http://homeassistant.local:1880`) and log in with a Home Assistant user.

data_description.nodered_url: The address of the Node-RED editor without the trailing `#flow/...`, for example `http://192.168.1.10:1880`. If you set `httpAdminRoot` in settings.js, add that path, for example `http://192.168.1.10:1880/admin`.
data_description.nodered_username: Only if the editor asks for a login (`adminAuth` in settings.js, or a Home Assistant user for the add-on). Leave empty otherwise.
data_description.nodered_token: Use this instead of username and password if you already have a Node-RED admin access token (for example from `adminAuth.tokens` in settings.js). Leave empty otherwise.

abort.busy: A plan, an undo or a purge is running. The options can be changed afterwards.

error.nodered_cannot_connect: Node-RED could not be reached at this address.
error.nodered_invalid_auth: Node-RED rejected the login or token.
error.nodered_invalid_response: The address answered, but not with Node-RED flows.

orphaned_entities.title: {count} orphaned entities
orphaned_entities.description: Housekeeper found {count} entities whose device, integration or state no longer exists. [Show in Housekeeper]({link}). Nothing is changed automatically.

unavailable_entities.title: {count} entities unavailable for a long time
unavailable_entities.description: Housekeeper found {count} entities that have been unavailable longer than the configured threshold. [Show in Housekeeper]({link}). Nothing is changed automatically.

broken_automations.title: {count} findings with missing references
broken_automations.description: Housekeeper found {count} references to entities, devices or areas that no longer exist, in automations, scripts, scenes, dashboards, groups or helpers. [Show in Housekeeper]({link}). Nothing is changed automatically.
